name: Luke Charles Stafford
also_credited_as: Actor (36), Director (8), Writer (7), Producer (5), Composer (4), Editor (1). Only the ACTOR credits are staged.
AKA_TO_ADD: IMDb records the alternative name 'Lucas Stafford', billed that way on 'Fuel to Our Fire: My Racer Stepbrother' and "I'm Pregnant, Let's Break Up!". people.csv already holds 'Lukas Charles Stafford', so this is an APPEND.
CORRECTS_AN_EARLIER_CLASSIFICATION: people.csv's existing 'Lukas Charles Stafford' was written by commit 930d17eab as one of '20 actor typo akas'. It is NOT a typo. IMDb's own bio for him OPENS with 'Lukas Charles Stafford is an American actor, singer, and songwriter', and two further credits are billed '(as Lukas Charles Stafford)' - Secret Society of Lies and Megalodon Rising. It is a genuine former or alternate billing. That matters beyond this one row: the 18 July pass filed 20 variants as typos, and at least one of them was real, so that classification should not be trusted wholesale.
NOTABLE: 36 actor credits, 21 of them vertical, against 20 on file. He is a working musician and director as well - a Broadway credit, a SAG feature, and a single - which is unusual for this batch.
LAYOUT_TRAP_RECOVERED: Eighth page hit: 'Carrie Underwood: Dirty Laundry Previous 7.1 33' then 'Music Video Man Love Interest 2016' - the 'Previous 33' control is wedged between the title and its rating. Non-vertical and excluded anyway, but recorded because it is the same failure.
non_vertical_excluded_note: Excluded as non-vertical: East of Middle West (2021 SAG feature), Megalodon Rising (2021), the TV movies Road Trip Hostage and Secret Society of Lies, the music videos Still Missin You and Carrie Underwood: Dirty Laundry, and the shorts The Rescuer, Green Ultra, Nerdy Teen Stops Home Break In, What Is Love?, Love Does, By & By.
